title: The Queens Poet Open Mic @ QED Astoria
event_description: A monthly Astoria open mic for poetry singer-songwriters and spoken word with no stand-up comedy. Names are drawn from a bucket for three to five minute sets in a woman-owned arts space.
backline: Phone-connected backing tracks allowed with advance notice to the host; otherwise bring your own instrument
event_venue_information:
QED Astoria

QED is an independent arts space in Astoria known as the only woman-owned and operated venue of its kind in Queens, hosting a wide calendar of comedy, storytelling, poetry and music events.

The Queens Poet Open Mic

On the first Saturday of the month from 3:30 PM to 5:00 PM, QED runs The Queens Poet, an open mic focused on poetry, singer-songwriters and spoken word rather than stand-up comedy. Sign-up happens in person starting at 3:00 PM and names are drawn from a bucket for a first-come first-served running order, with each performer getting a three to five minute set. Musicians may use phone-connected backing tracks with the host's prior notice. A five dollar minimum purchase is requested.

Other Programming

QED also runs a nightly general open mic series that mixes comedians poets and musicians, alongside a broader calendar of comedy and arts programming throughout the week.

Good to Know

QED Astoria is located at 27-16 23rd Avenue in Astoria, a short walk from the N/W Astoria-Ditmars Blvd station.

title: Astoria Music Collective Open Mic @ Shillelagh Tavern
event_description: A weekly Astoria open mic hosted by the Astoria Music Collective inside a traditional Irish sports pub. Local musicians play originals and covers across all genres in a laid-back neighborhood setting.
event_venue_information:
Shillelagh Tavern

Shillelagh Tavern is a traditional Irish sports pub in Astoria that hosts live music several nights a week alongside its regular bar and sports-viewing crowd.

The Open Mic

Every Wednesday at 8:00 PM the Astoria Music Collective runs a weekly open mic at the tavern, welcoming local musicians to play original songs and covers across all genres in a casual pub setting.

Other Programming

The tavern's calendar includes additional live-music nights run by community groups throughout the week, in keeping with its role as a neighborhood gathering spot.

Good to Know

Shillelagh Tavern is located at 47-22 30th Avenue in Astoria.

title: Saturday Songwriters Open Mic @ The Local Bar
event_description: A weekly Astoria open mic for singer-songwriters performing originals and covers. Performers who sign up receive a free drink at this neighborhood bar hub for local music.
event_venue_information:
The Local Bar

The Local Bar is a neighborhood bar in Astoria that has become a hub for local live music, running multiple recurring music nights for the community.

Saturday Songwriters Open Mic

Every Saturday, sign-up begins at 3:00 PM with the show starting at 4:00 PM. Hosted by the Astoria Music Collective, the open mic welcomes singer-songwriters playing both original material and covers, and performers who sign up receive a free drink.

Other Programming

The Local Bar also hosts additional live-music nights and community events throughout the month, reinforcing its role as a gathering spot for Astoria musicians.

Good to Know

The Local Bar is located at 41-04 31st Avenue in Astoria.

title: The Underground Open Mic @ Bar Freda
event_description: A weekly Ridgewood open mic inside a two-floor rock venue and LGBTQ+ safe space. Free admission welcomes music and spoken word performers in a laid-back dive bar setting.
hosts: Sunbeam Colleen, I'm Not Holden Caufield, and Road to Ruin
event_venue_information:
Bar Freda

Bar Freda is a two-floor Ridgewood venue billed as an NYC rock venue downstairs with a lounge upstairs, and it operates as an LGBTQ+ safe space with live music programmed most nights of the week.

The Underground Open Mic

Every Monday from 7:30 PM to 11:30 PM, with sign-up starting at 8:00 PM, Bar Freda hosts The Underground, a free open mic for music and spoken-word performers, hosted by Sunbeam Colleen, I'm Not Holden Caufield, and Road to Ruin.

Other Programming

Bar Freda advertises live music every night, making it one of Ridgewood's most consistently active venues for local and touring rock acts.

Good to Know

Bar Freda is located at 801 Seneca Avenue in Ridgewood.

title: Weekly Jazz Jam Session @ Terraza 7
event_description: The only weekly jazz jam session in Queens hosted by bassist John Benitez. Latin jazz and straight ahead jazz musicians of all levels are welcome at this intimate Elmhurst listening room.
event_venue_information:
Terraza 7

Terraza 7 is an intimate live-music venue in Elmhurst that has specialized in Latin, jazz, Caribbean and world music for more than two decades, seating around seventy guests in a warm listening-room atmosphere.

Weekly Jazz Jam Session

Every Sunday from 8:30 PM to 11:55 PM, bassist John Benitez hosts what the venue calls the only weekly jazz jam session in Queens, blending Latin jazz, Brazilian music and straight-ahead jazz standards. All musicians are welcome to sit in, with a five dollar cover for mezzanine access.

Other Programming

Terraza 7 also partners with Queens College and community arts organizations on periodic jazz jam series for emerging musicians, in addition to a full calendar of ticketed world-music and jazz shows.

Good to Know

Terraza 7 is located at 40-19 Gleane Street in Elmhurst.

title: Monthly Jazz Jam @ Flushing Town Hall
event_description: A long-running monthly jazz jam led by saxophonist Carol Sudhalter at a nonprofit performing arts center. Serious hobbyists students and professional musicians all sit in on a grand piano and full drum kit.
event_time_plain: Evening, day of month varies by month; check the venue calendar for the exact date
hosts: Carol Sudhalter with Joe Vincent Tranchina, Scott Neumann, and Eric Lemon
backline: Steinway baby grand piano and drum kit provided
event_venue_information:
Flushing Town Hall

Flushing Town Hall is a nonprofit performing arts center in a historic building, running a full calendar of theater, gallery and music programming for the Queens community.

Monthly Jazz Jam

Held once a month year-round on a date that varies, the Monthly Jazz Jam is led by saxophonist Carol Sudhalter alongside Joe Vincent Tranchina, Scott Neumann and Eric Lemon. It welcomes professional jazz musicians, graduate music students, educators and serious hobbyists on all instruments and voice, with a Steinway baby grand piano and full drum kit provided. Non-musicians are welcome to attend as audience members.

Other Programming

Flushing Town Hall runs a wide range of concerts, exhibitions and educational programs throughout the year, occasionally including jazz-poetry open mic variants of the jam.

Good to Know

Flushing Town Hall is located at 137-35 Northern Boulevard in Flushing. Because the jam's exact date shifts month to month, check the venue's calendar before visiting.

title: Queens Open Mic @ Grey Studios LIC
event_description: A monthly Long Island City open mic run by literary arts organization Keepsake House. Original music storytelling and spoken word are welcome with BIPOC and LGBTQ plus artists especially encouraged.
venue_address: 39-45 Crescent Street, Long Island City, NY 11101
event_venue_information:
Grey Studios LIC

Grey Studios LIC is a recording and live-room studio space in Long Island City used to host a recurring community open mic in partnership with the literary and arts organization Keepsake House.

Queens Open Mic

Held monthly on the first Sunday from 3:30 PM to 6:00 PM (doors at 3:00 PM), the open mic mixes music, storytelling and spoken word in an all-genre format, with BIPOC and LGBTQ+ artists performing original work especially encouraged. Performers get roughly two songs or ten minutes each, and the host rotates monthly. Online pre-registration is encouraged via Keepsake House. Admission is ten dollars at the door, including a snack and non-alcoholic drink, and free for members.

Other Programming

Keepsake House runs additional literary and community arts programming beyond its monthly Queens open mic series.

Good to Know

Grey Studios LIC is located at 39-45 Crescent Street in Long Island City.

title: Open Mic Night @ Chano's Cantina
event_description: A weekly family friendly open mic at an Astoria Mexican restaurant and bar. All acts including music are welcome for a relaxed neighborhood evening of local performance.
event_venue_information:
Chano's Cantina

Chano's Cantina is a Mexican restaurant and bar in Astoria that hosts a weekly open mic alongside its regular dinner and drinks service.

The Open Mic

Every Wednesday from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM, with sign-up starting at 7:30 PM, Chano's runs a family-friendly open mic hosted by Michael Lloret, welcoming musicians and other performers for a relaxed neighborhood evening.

Other Programming

Chano's Cantina functions primarily as a neighborhood restaurant and bar, with the open mic serving as its regular weekly live-entertainment night.

Good to Know

Chano's Cantina is located at 35-55 31st Street in Astoria. It is worth calling ahead to confirm the open mic is running as scheduled.
